line.en: scottish premiership, gameweek 15, kick-off 15:00 at ibrox. the ibrox subway station is right by the stadium; allow time for the crowds.
line.de: scottish premiership, spieltag 15, anpfiff 15:00 im ibrox. die u-bahn-station ibrox liegt direkt am stadion; zeit für die menge einplanen.
line.tr: scottish premiership, 15. hafta, başlama 15:00, ibrox'ta. ibrox metro istasyonu stadyumun hemen yanında; kalabalık için zaman ayır.

sparks.why: Rangers v Falkirk, Scottish Premiership gameweek 15, Sat 28 Nov at Ibrox; 15:00 kick-off per Football Web Pages (Sports Mole lists the same fixture without a time), so check the SPFL or Rangers site before going.

line.en: glasgow's saturday market on gallowgate, open 10:00 to 16:00. vintage, records, old things; go before lunch for the best stalls.
line.de: glasgows samstagsmarkt an der gallowgate, 10 bis 16 uhr. vintage, schallplatten, trödel; geh vor dem mittag für die besten stände.
line.tr: glasgow'un cumartesi pazarı, gallowgate'te; 10:00 ile 16:00 arası açık. vintage, plak, eski eşya; en iyi stantlar için öğleden önce git.

sparks.why: The Barras is a regular Saturday market on Gallowgate, 10:00 to 16:00, per the Barrowland market's own site as cited for the 7 November file; not re-checked for this date.
